title: Language membership indicator
statement: Given a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet, define a Boolean-valued function of an index $j mod 4$ and a Boolean word $V$ that is true exactly when $V$ belongs to the language at index $j$ in the four-language tuple associated with $N$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
